tfp: Exact inverse annual cost rule. Both raw paths start at 1 in 2010, where historical net contribution is zero, and share factual-2017 normalization; country S1/S0 multiplier equals C_actual/C_cf. Existing cumulative-capacity regional weights retained; these differ from fixed 2024 net-added-capacity sample reporting weights in Section 3.1.
physical_constraints: No renewable-specific capital stock, no generation ceiling, no equipment investment satellite. Shared regional capital remains.
capacity: Generation divided by fixed reference capacity factor: capacity equivalent, not independently modelled GW stock.
calibration: Baseline GDP and historical renewable generation calibrated; future electricity CES preferences calibrated to 11000 GW equivalent in 2030, then frozen. All calibrated coefficients fixed across scenarios.
future: Covered country technology productivity paths frozen at 2024; uncovered reference paths use legacy inputs through 2030, frozen thereafter; zero direct shock unless global proxy selected.
carbon: Uniform real increment starts 2017, full-trajectory search to 2030 target; selected increment held through 2050. Original government-budget recycling.
capital: Shared regional capital: exact compounding of original annual depreciation/investment recursion over 3/5 years; no technology stock constraints.
corrections: Retain repaired non-power carbon charges and explicit saving/investment closure; repair two household import energy/emission source filenames. Not a bit-for-bit reproduction of old buggy code.
scenario_basis: Historical China-related net cost contribution; same annual model-factual and model-without-China-contribution curves as Section 3.1; not a deployment-only causal counterfactual.
cost_cf: Section 3.1 model_without_china_contribution = model_factual + P_direct + S_share + T_cn_tariff + K_spillover + G_other
changes_from_previous: Replace deployment-only costs with the complete historical net contribution on the same country model cost paths plotted in Section 3.1.
Recalibrate S0 for the changed factual productivity paths, retaining identical macro and renewable reference targets.
Keep signed historical contributions, including negative early wind values; no clipping.
